algorithm.contentSourceNever: the working tree (fs.readFile on repository content is forbidden)
algorithm.pathFormat: POSIX relative to repository root, no leading ./
algorithm.sorting: ordinal by path (UTF-16 code unit order, locale-independent)
algorithm.normalization: none: blob bytes are hashed exactly as committed

encoding.policy: every blob must be plain LF text unless .gitattributes declares it '-text' (binary macro or explicit)

worktree.note: worktree facts are recorded for audit only and are NOT part of compositeSha256/bindingSha256
